lines.en: label mall10:
scene mall2
I show up at the mall a little later than usual after getting caught up in traffic.
lines.zh: 因为堵车，我到商场比平时晚了一些。

lines.en: Chika’s break should have already ended by now, so I guess I’ll wind up hanging out with her at her work again today.
lines.zh: Chika 的休息应该早就结束了，所以我想今天又得在她工作的地方陪她了。

lines.en: Not like that’s a problem, though.
lines.zh: 不过这也不是什么问题。

lines.en: In fact, it might be {i}good{/i} that I showed up late because it increases the chances of her taking her clothes off for me.
lines.zh: 事实上，我迟到可能还是件{i}好事{/i}，因为这样她当着我的面脱衣服的概率就更高了。

lines.en: Obviously, she'd be putting on {i}different{/i} clothes and not letting me watch the act of doing so- but either way. She is taking off her clothes for me.
lines.zh: 当然，她会穿上{i}别的{/i}衣服，也不会让我看她脱的过程——不过不管怎么说。她是在为我脱衣服。

lines.en: And that is all I need to know.
lines.zh: 而我只需要知道这一点就够了。

lines.en: scene black
scene mallfive1
: Heya! Welcome-
lines.zh: : 嘿呀！欢迎-

lines.en: : Ah! Sensei!
lines.zh: : 啊！Sensei！

lines.en: scene mallfive2
: Great timing. I was just thinking about you.
lines.zh: : 来得正好。我刚才正想着你呢。

lines.en: : You mean you aren’t {i}always{/i} thinking about me? Bummer.
lines.zh: : 你是说你不是{i}时时刻刻{/i}都在想我？真扫兴。

lines.en: scene mallfive3
: Cut me some slack, Sensei! If I spent literally {i}all day{/i} thinking about you, I’d forget to come to work and lose my job and it would be like, a whole thing.
lines.zh: : 饶了我吧，Sensei！要是我真的{i}一整天{/i}都在想你，我会忘了来上班、丢掉工作，然后就变成一整套麻烦事。

lines.en: : Besides, there's no way you think about me even half as much as I think about you.
lines.zh: : 再说，你想我的次数不可能有我想你的一半多。

lines.en: Sure I do. I just can't talk about the majority of those thoughts out loud.
lines.zh: 我当然会。只是那些念头大部分都不能说出口。

lines.en: : I suppose that you dedicating any amount of time to me is more than enough, but I still implore you to try and fit more in whenever possible.
lines.zh: : 我想，你愿意把任何时间花在我身上都已经足够了，但我还是要恳求你，尽可能多地挤出一点来。

lines.en: scene mallfive9
: I'll see if I can pull some strings and make that happen.
lines.zh: : 我看看能不能疏通一下，把这事办成。

lines.en: : So, you ready?
lines.zh: : 那么，你准备好了吗？

lines.en: : Ready for what?
lines.zh: : 准备好什么？

lines.en: : Seeing me try some stuff on, dummy! That's why you came, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 看我试衣服啊，笨蛋！你不就是为这个来的吗？

lines.en: : I mean...that wasn't the {i}only{/i} reason.
lines.zh: : 嗯……那不是{i}唯一{/i}的原因。

lines.en: : Well, I'm ready whenever you are.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我随时都可以。

lines.en: scene mallfive4
: Plus, I found a dress that I might actually look good in, so...
lines.zh: : 而且，我找到了一条我穿起来可能真的还不错的裙子，所以……

lines.en: : Do you need any help putting it on?
lines.zh: : 需要我帮忙穿吗？

lines.en: scene mallfive9
: Mmm...no. I think I can handle that part myself. You can follow me over to the dressing room, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不用。这部分我自己能搞定。不过你可以跟我去试衣间那边。

lines.en: : And if there’s anything you wanna try on, just let me know. Maybe I can judge you after you do me?
lines.zh: : 要是有什么你想试穿的，跟我说就行。也许你评完我之后，我也能评评你？

lines.en: : You can do me whenever you want, Chika.
lines.zh: : 你想什么时候「评」我都行，Chika。

lines.en: scene mallfive2
: Thanks! Just follow me to the-
lines.zh: : 谢啦！跟我来-

lines.en: scene mallfive8
: Wait! No! I said a weird thing again! I didn't mean it like that!
lines.zh: : 等等！不！我又说了奇怪的话！我不是那个意思！

lines.en: : So...we're {i}not{/i} going to do each other?
lines.zh: : 所以……我们{i}不{/i}是要互相「做」？

lines.en: : Not yet!
lines.zh: : 还没到时候！

lines.en: : But doesn't that imply-
lines.zh: : 可这不就意味着-

lines.en: : Nope!
lines.zh: : 不意味着！

lines.en: : Anyway! Time to get dressed!
lines.zh: : 总之！该换衣服了！

lines.en: scene black
Chika awkwardly shuffles her way over to a separate part of the store, straightening out her skirt and shaking off whatever nerves started acting up as a result of her inappropriate wording just now.
lines.zh: Chika 局促地挪到店里另一区，一边把裙子拉直，一边甩掉刚才因为措辞不当而冒出来的紧张。

lines.en: I have to do the same, but it's less {i}awkward{/i} and I can't imagine it looking even half as attractive.
lines.zh: 我也不得不这么做，只不过没那么{i}尴尬{/i}，而且我想象不出那画面能有她一半好看。

lines.en: Either way, she stops in front of the dressing rooms before turning to face me.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，她在试衣间前停下，转身面对我。

lines.en: scene mallten1
: Okay, so. Disclaimer-
lines.zh: : 好，那么。免责声明-

lines.en: : I’ve already told you that dresses aren’t my thing...so even if I said that I like this one...please don’t expect too much.
lines.zh: : 我说过了连衣裙不是我的菜……所以就算我说我喜欢这条……也请别抱太大期望。

lines.en: : Deal.
lines.zh: : 成交。

lines.en: : Great. Disclaimer part two-
lines.zh: : 很好。免责声明第二条-

lines.en: : Make sure you wait until I’m done getting dressed to actually come in.
lines.zh: : 一定要等我穿好衣服才能进来。

lines.en: scene mallten2
: I liked the first disclaimer more.
lines.zh: : 我更喜欢第一条免责声明。

lines.en: : I bet you did, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我就知道你会，Sensei。

lines.en: : And remember- I’m still {i}technically{/i} at work, even if there aren’t any customers right now.
lines.zh: : 还有记住-就算现在一个客人都没有，我{i}严格来说{/i}还是在上班。

lines.en: : I hope there's not a third disclaimer stating that I need to help any of them while you're getting changed.
lines.zh: : 希望没有第三条免责声明，说你换衣服的时候我得去招呼客人。

lines.en: : Chika, I don't know how-
lines.zh: : Chika，我不知道该怎么-

lines.en: scene mallten3
: Then, I guess all we can do is hope that nobody comes in!
lines.zh: : 那，我们只能祈祷没人进来了！

lines.en: : But yeah! Other than that, just don’t make fun of me when I look like a fish out of water and we'll be all good!
lines.zh: : 不过对！除此之外，只要别在我像离水的鱼一样手足无措的时候笑话我，就万事大吉！

lines.en: : Sounds easy enough. Apart from the idea of helping customers, I mean.
lines.zh: : 听起来不难。除了要帮忙招呼客人那部分。

lines.en: : Great! Then, hang out here for a couple minutes while I get dressed and...I'll see you soon.
lines.zh: : 太好了！那么，在这儿待几分钟，我去换衣服，然后……待会儿见。

lines.en: : Sure thing. Let me know if your bra gets stuck and you need help getting it off.
lines.zh: : 没问题。要是你胸罩卡住了、需要帮忙脱，就告诉我。

lines.en: : One of the hooks is already broken, so I doubt that'll be a problem. But thanks for the offer.
lines.zh: : 有个搭扣本来就坏了，所以我觉得不会有这个问题。不过谢谢你的好意。

lines.en: scene black
Chika disappears into the dressing room and I can hear her clothes beginning to fall to the floor moments later.
lines.zh: Chika 消失在试衣间里，片刻之后我就听见她的衣服开始往地上掉。

lines.en: It takes every ounce of self-control I have to not sneak in there, but I respect Chika's wishes and remain outside.
lines.zh: 我用尽了全部自制力才没溜进去，但我尊重 Chika 的意愿，留在外面。

lines.en: I'm sure a day will come when I don't have to do that anymore but, for now, the best way for me to get closer to her is to respect the very few boundaries she actually establishes.
lines.zh: 我相信总有一天我不用再这样了，但现在，能让我靠近她的最好方式，就是尊重她为数不多真正划下的界线。

lines.en: I know that, at the end of the day, she is taking her clothes off for me right now.
lines.zh: 我知道，归根到底，她现在是在为我脱衣服。

lines.en: So I justify my wait by reiterating that single thought over and over in my head until the time finally comes to-
lines.zh: 于是我在脑子里一遍遍重复这个念头，为自己的等待找理由，直到那个时刻终于降临-

lines.en: : Sensei! I'm...suddenly having second thoughts about this.
lines.zh: : Sensei！我……突然对这件事产生动摇了。

lines.en: The time comes sooner than expected.
lines.zh: 那一刻来得比预想中更早。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: : 什么？为什么？

lines.en: : Because I look like a freaking idiot.
lines.zh: : 因为我看起来像个彻头彻尾的傻子。

lines.en: : Chika-
lines.zh: : Chika-

lines.en: : Fine! Fine...
lines.zh: : 好吧！好吧……

lines.en: : You can come in, just...
lines.zh: : 你可以进来了，只是……

lines.en: : I'm sorry in advance for the disappointment...
lines.zh: : 先为让你失望道歉……

lines.en: scene black
I follow the sound of Chika's voice, slightly muffled by a thick red curtain-
lines.zh: 我循着 Chika 的声音走去，声音被厚重的红色帘子闷住了几分-

lines.en: scene mallten4
And stumble upon a wonderful sight.
lines.zh: 然后撞见了一幅美妙的景象。

lines.en: : Yeahhh, so...I kinda thought I’d look a little cuter than this...but it’s whatever, I guess.
lines.zh: : 那个……就是说……我本来以为自己穿这个会可爱一点……算了，无所谓吧。

lines.en: : Dresses just aren’t my thing. I promise I’ll wear something more exciting next time.
lines.zh: : 连衣裙就是不适合我。我保证下次穿点更刺激的。

lines.en: : Maybe not something as exciting as {i}lingerie{/i}, but...
lines.zh: : 也许不会像{i}内衣{/i}那么刺激，不过……

lines.en: : Don’t say that. Just because it's different from how you normally look doesn't mean it's {i}bad.{/i}
lines.zh: : 别这么说。只是跟你平时的样子不一样，不代表就{i}不好{/i}。

lines.en: : It doesn't mean it's {i}good{/i} either, though...
lines.zh: : 可也不代表就{i}好{/i}啊……

lines.en: : Like...how do you really think I look like dressed in stuff like this, Sensei? Be honest.
lines.zh: : 就是……你老实说，我穿成这样到底看起来怎么样，Sensei？说实话。

lines.en: menu:
I think you look beautiful
lines.zh: 我觉得你很美

lines.en: : I think you’re beautiful, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你很美，Chika。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s what I-
lines.zh: : 嗯，我就是这个-

lines.en: scene mallten10
: Wait, what? Who? Me?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？谁？我？

lines.en: : What did you just say?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说什么？

lines.en: : I said I think you look beautiful.
lines.zh: : 我说我觉得你看起来很美。

lines.en: : Yeah, but like...sarcastically, right? Like what you {i}really{/i} think is that I resemble an out-of-place[teen]on her way to Easter breakfast with her grandparents.
lines.zh: : 是吗，可……是讽刺吧？你{i}真正{/i}想的是，我像个格格不入的[teen]正要去跟祖父母吃复活节早餐。

lines.en: : I would...never think something that specific. I just genuinely think you look great.
lines.zh: : 我……绝不会想到那么具体的事。我是真心觉得你很好看。

lines.en: : You...You know that I’ll still like you even if you tell me the truth, right? You don't have to be nice 100%% of the time.
lines.zh: : 你……你知道就算你说实话我也还是会喜欢你，对吧？你不用 100%% 的时候都这么温柔。

lines.en: : I am telling you the truth.
lines.zh: : 我说的是实话。

lines.en: : And you know I’ll still eventually do the lingerie thing even if you don’t compliment literally everything I ever wear, right?
lines.zh: : 而且你知道，就算你不夸我穿的每一件衣服，我迟早也还是会做那件内衣的事，对吧？

lines.en: : Just accept the compliment, Chika.
lines.zh: : 接受夸奖就行，Chika。

lines.en: scene mallten11
: Ahhhhh! I wanna! It’s just super embarrassing and I didn’t expect you to say anything good!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊！我想啊！只是超级难为情，而且我没想到你会说什么好话！

lines.en: : Maybe you just...need to take a closer look or something?! I don't know!
lines.zh: : 也许你只是……需要凑近一点看什么的？！我不知道！

lines.en: : You wear glasses so your eyes are probably bad and-
lines.zh: : 你戴眼镜，所以眼睛可能不好，然后-

lines.en: : Fine.
lines.zh: : 好吧。

lines.en: scene mallten12
: Nope. Still beautiful.
lines.zh: : 没有。还是很美。

lines.en: : Oh my God. A real kabedon. Am I dreaming?
lines.zh: : 天哪。真的壁咚。我是在做梦吗？

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Nothing. Don't stop.
lines.zh: : 没什么。别停。

lines.en: : Uhh...I don't really know what else there is to say other than you still look great.
lines.zh: : 呃……除了你看起来还是很棒之外，我真不知道还能说什么。

lines.en: : You’re not even looking at the dress anymore.
lines.zh: : 你连裙子都不看了。

lines.en: : Yeah. There's something else I like looking at a little more.
lines.zh: : 嗯。有别的东西我更想看一点。

lines.en: : Oh my fucking God, my hot teacher is kabedoning me. I'm in an anime. This isn't real.
lines.zh: : 我操，我那帅哥老师正在壁咚我。我在动漫里。这不是真的。

lines.en: Chika presses her back against the mirror not to get away, but to make herself more comfortable.
lines.zh: Chika 把背贴在镜子上，不是为了躲开，而是为了让自己更舒服。

lines.en: She's obviously surprised by me suddenly closing the distance like this...but she {i}was{/i} the one who suggested it, so...
lines.zh: 她显然被我突然拉近距离吓了一跳……但{i}是{/i}她自己提议的，所以……

lines.en: scene mallten13
: Your...
lines.zh: : 你的……

lines.en: : Has anyone ever told you how pretty your eyes are?...
lines.zh: : 有人说过你的眼睛有多好看吗？……

lines.en: : And like, not even just that...you're straight up {i}really{/i} attractive up close...
lines.zh: : 而且不只是那样……近距离看你简直{i}真的{/i}很迷人……

lines.en: : I'll make sure to get as close as I can when I flirt from now on, then.
lines.zh: : 那我从今往后调情的时候，一定会尽量靠得近一点。

lines.en: : Do you...really not have a girlfriend?
lines.zh: : 你……真的没有女朋友吗？

lines.en: : I already told you. I’m preoccupied with a bunch of [teenager]s instead.
lines.zh: : 我已经说过了。我忙着应付一堆[teenager]呢。

lines.en: : Sorry, I just...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是……

lines.en: : My heart’s beating out of control right now and it’s kinda hard to remember stuff.
lines.zh: : 我现在心跳快得不行，实在有点记不清事了。

lines.en: : Is it?
lines.zh: : 是吗？

lines.en: : Uh-huh...
lines.zh: : 嗯哼……

lines.en: : And why is that, Chika?
lines.zh: : 那是为什么呢，Chika？

lines.en: scene mallten14
: Oh, I don't know, Sensei! Why do you think?!
lines.zh: : 哦，我怎么知道，Sensei！你觉得呢？！

lines.en: : Is that sass I hear right now?
lines.zh: : 我听到的是顶嘴吗？

lines.en: scene mallten15
: Are you gonna give me detention if I say yes?
lines.zh: : 我要是说是，你会给我留堂吗？

lines.en: : I am now. Please drop by my office after[school] as soon as possible.
lines.zh: : 现在会了。请[school]之后尽快来我办公室一趟。

lines.en: : What are you gonna make me do, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你要让我做什么，Sensei？

lines.en: : I guess we’ll find out soon enough, won’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们很快就会知道了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Is it wrong for me to be a little excited?
lines.zh: : 我有点兴奋，这有错吗？

lines.en: : Do you want the real answer or the hotter one?
lines.zh: : 你想听真正的答案，还是更火辣的那个？

lines.en: : Gimme the hotter one.
lines.zh: : 给我更火辣的那个。

lines.en: : Then, no.
lines.zh: : 那么，没错。

lines.en: : I've never had a detention before, Sensei. You might have to give me directions.
lines.zh: : 我从没被留过堂，Sensei。你可能得给我指个路。

lines.en: This is so much better than lingerie.
lines.zh: 这可比内衣好太多了。

lines.en: scene mallten16
I bring my hand to Chika’s face, not knowing exactly how she'll react but, as you can see, it works out pretty favorably.
lines.zh: 我抬手抚上 Chika 的脸，不确定她会有什么反应，但如你所见，结果相当顺利。

lines.en: : About time.
lines.zh: : 早该这样了。

lines.en: : Am I moving too slow for you?
lines.zh: : 我动作太慢了吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene mallten17
: Ahm~
lines.zh: : 啊嗯~

lines.en: Oh.
lines.zh: 哦。

lines.en: Oh, okay.
lines.zh: 哦，好吧。

lines.en: : Mnh...mmm...
scene mallten18
: Mnch...mmm...
In a welcome turn of events, Chika slowly and gently wraps her tongue around my thumb, sensually taking as much of it into her mouth as she can.
lines.zh: 事情的发展很讨人喜欢，Chika 缓慢而温柔地用舌头缠住我的拇指，性感地把它尽可能多地含进嘴里。

lines.en: To say I'm shocked is a bit of an understatement, but she's been more or less full of surprises thus far and the idea of her being into things like {i}this{/i} isn't too absurd.
lines.zh: 说我震惊都算轻描淡写了，不过她到目前为止或多或少都充满惊喜，她会喜欢{i}这种{/i}事也不算太离谱。

lines.en: And again, this is so much better than lingerie.
lines.zh: 再说一遍，这可比内衣好太多了。

lines.en: : Mm...mm...you like that, Sensei?...
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯……你喜欢吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : This is...amf...what you wanted...right?...
lines.zh: : 这就是……呜姆……你想要的……对吧？……

lines.en: scene mallten19
: Oh my God. Please tell me I didn't just {i}dramatically{/i} misread the situation.
lines.zh: : 天哪。请告诉我我刚才没有{i}严重地{/i}会错意。

lines.en: : Cause I really thought that was where we were going with that and-
lines.zh: : 因为我真的以为事情就是要往那边发展，然后-

lines.en: : No, it's just...I'm a little surprised.
lines.zh: : 不，只是……我有点惊讶。

lines.en: : I thought you were innocent, is all.
lines.zh: : 我只是以为你很单纯。

lines.en: : I am innocent!
lines.zh: : 我很单纯啊！

lines.en: : The saliva all over my thumb begs to differ.
lines.zh: : 我拇指上全是口水，它可不这么认为。

lines.en: : That's...I don't know, Sensei! It seemed like the right thing to do at the time!
lines.zh: : 那是……我不知道，Sensei！当时那看起来就是该做的事！

lines.en: : I just got worried that you were talking about an {i}actual{/i} detention when you stopped talking and just let me keep going and...and...
lines.zh: : 我只是担心你说的是{i}真的{/i}留堂，结果你不说话了，还让我继续……然后……

lines.en: scene mallten20
: And your thumbs are big! You should...apologize! For...for having such...
lines.zh: : 而且你的拇指好大！你应该……道歉！因为……因为长着这么……

lines.en: : Such...large...
lines.zh: : 这么……大的……

lines.en: : I'm going back to work now!
lines.zh: : 我回去工作了！

lines.en: scene black
Chika storms out of the dressing room and, once I follow her out, she begs me for the next ten minutes to forget any of that ever happened.
lines.zh: Chika 冲出试衣间，我跟出去之后，她花了整整十分钟求我把刚才的事忘掉。

lines.en: Well, not {i}any{/i} of it- but the part where she started fellating my finger.
lines.zh: 好吧，不是{i}全部{/i}-只是她开始舔我手指那部分。

lines.en: Regardless, it’s clear now that there’s at least some form of chemistry between us.
lines.zh: 无论如何，现在很清楚，我们之间至少存在某种化学反应。

lines.en: What that chemistry {i}is{/i} remains to be determined.
lines.zh: 那种化学反应到底{i}是{/i}什么，还有待确定。

lines.en: But once it reaches its full potential-
lines.zh: 但等它发挥到极致-

lines.en: I can see Chika becoming someone I'll never forget.
lines.zh: 我看得出来，Chika 会变成一个我永远忘不掉的人。

lines.en: Oh, and also, she is good with her tongue.
lines.zh: 哦，还有，她舌头很厉害。

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
I think you look fine
lines.zh: 我觉得你看起来很好

lines.en: : I think you look fine.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你看起来很好。

lines.en: : Sure, it’s not as fitting as your normal clothes, but you’re still adorable.
lines.zh: : 当然，它没有你平时的衣服那么合身，但你还是很可爱。

lines.en: scene mallten5
: Guh...Maybe if I started, like...styling my hair differently, I could pull stuff like this off?
lines.zh: : 呜……也许要是我……换个发型什么的，我就能撑起这种风格？

lines.en: : I’m sure makeup plays some part in it too, but that's like, a crazy amount of work.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定妆容也起了点作用，但那工作量也太夸张了。

lines.en: scene mallten6
: Sorry for subjecting you to this, Sensei. Just can't help but feel like I should maybe try and change up my image every once in a while.
lines.zh: : 抱歉让你看这个，Sensei。就是忍不住觉得，也许我该偶尔试着改变一下形象。

lines.en: : What are you apologizing for? I don't see anything wrong with your normal style.
lines.zh: : 你道什么歉？我觉得你平时的风格没任何问题。

lines.en: : I don't know. It's just that the whole gyaru thing attracts some unwanted attention at times.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。只是这种辣妹风格有时候会招来一些不必要的关注。

lines.en: scene mallten7
: Plus, you hanging around with a girl who looks like I do might...send some bad signals out or something.
lines.zh: : 而且，你跟一个我这样打扮的女孩混在一起，可能会……发出一些不好的信号什么的。

lines.en: : Dress however you want to dress, Chika. Don't tailor your style to fit me or anyone else.
lines.zh: : 你想怎么穿就怎么穿，Chika。别为了迎合我或者别人去改你的风格。

lines.en: : If you like it, wear it. That's really all there is to it.
lines.zh: : 喜欢就穿。就这么简单。

lines.en: scene mallten8
: Yeah...Yeah, that's a good point.
lines.zh: : 嗯……嗯，说得对。

lines.en: : As long as you don’t think I look weird or whatever, I’ll probs just keep dressing how I have been.
lines.zh: : 只要你不觉得我看起来很怪什么的，我大概就会继续像现在这样穿。

lines.en: : It would suck having to buy a whole new wardrobe anyway...
lines.zh: : 反正要重新买一整柜衣服也挺惨的……

lines.en: : At least if you start saving now, you might be able to afford something here by the time you retire.
lines.zh: : 至少你要是从现在开始攒钱，退休的时候说不定能在这儿买得起一件。

lines.en: scene mallten9
: Hahah! Yeah...maybe.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！是啊……也许吧。

lines.en: scene mallten7
: Well, uhh...I guess I should probably be getting back to doing my job or whatever now.
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……我想我大概该回去干活了。

lines.en: : You’re sure no one saw you follow me in here, right?
lines.zh: : 你确定没人看见你跟着我进来了，对吧？

lines.en: : I...don’t remember checking, actually.
lines.zh: : 我……其实不记得有检查过。

lines.en: scene mallten8
: Oh well. We've been slow all day anyway, so I doubt there were any customers while we were in here.
lines.zh: : 算了。反正我们一整天都很闲，所以我们在里面的时候应该没有客人。

lines.en: : Just...you go out first and I'm sure everything will be alright. I still need to put my regular clothes back on anyway.
lines.zh: : 就是……你先出去，我肯定一切都会没事的。我反正还得把平时的衣服换回来。

lines.en: : It's fine. I'll stay for that part. I want to understand your process.
lines.zh: : 没关系。那部分我留下来。我想了解你的流程。

lines.en: scene mallten9
: You will most certainly not stay for that part, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那部分你绝对不能留下来，Sensei。

lines.en: : Well, you can't blame me for trying.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你不能怪我试试看。

lines.en: scene black
I exit the dressing room and Chika comes out a minute or two later.
lines.zh: 我走出试衣间，Chika 一两分钟之后也出来了。

lines.en: We chat for a little while longer before her boss calls and she needs to go over some inventory stuff with her.
lines.zh: 我们又聊了一会儿，直到她老板打电话来，她得去跟老板核对一些库存的事。

lines.en: As such, I exit the store and am once again subjected to aimlessly wandering the streets of Kumon-mi...
lines.zh: 于是我走出店门，又一次被迫在 Kumon-mi 的街道上漫无目的地闲逛……
